name: royal-jelly-eggs
description: A debug Wizard applies blessed royal jelly from a stack to a timed typed egg, cancels its hatch timer with cursed jelly, reapplies the remaining blessed lump, then cancels a split application to cover consumption, timer cancellation and rescheduling, and exact stack restoration.
